_comment: Autonomous systems that host servers, not readers. scripts/stats.py buckets every request from these as 'datacenter', whatever its volume — see the Hosting class there and the 10 sep 2026 diary entry. Keys that are not numbers (like this one) are ignored. Eyeball networks (Comcast, KPN, Verizon, BT) must never appear here: a real reader behind one is exactly the traffic we are trying to count.
